subject: Pre-invoice routing, PO guidance & annual commitment scheduling (Nimbus Health)
messages:
From: Elle Thompson <elle.thompson@nimbushealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: pre-invoice routing & PO guidance for Redwood annual commitment

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the performance numbers. Procurement here is starting the paperwork for the annual commitment we discussed. A couple of questions to make sure our AP and legal teams are aligned before we issue the blanket PO: 

- We typically issue a blanket PO that references the SOW and then we receive quarterly invoices against that PO. Is Redwood able to accept a quarterly invoice cadence tied to a single blanket PO?
- Our standard term is net60 — would Redwood accept net60 for the first year? If not, would you consider net60 with a small discount or a one-time exception on the first invoice?
- We require a pre-invoice/proforma 7 business days before each invoice cycle for internal sign-off. Can you provide a pre-invoice PDF (not the final invoice) in advance?

I've attached our PO template (Nimbus_PO_template.pdf) for your reference. Please let me know if you need GL codes, billing contact info, or a Redwood remit address to populate the PO.

Next steps: once we confirm terms and routing, procurement will issue the PO and we can route DocuSign for the SOW.

Thanks,
Elle Thompson
Senior Procurement Manager
Nimbus Health

(415) 555-0178

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elle Thompson <elle.thompson@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: pre-invoice routing & PO guidance for Redwood annual commitment

Hi Elle — appreciate the clear checklist and the template. Short answers up front: yes to blanket PO + quarterly invoices, we can provide a pre-invoice PDF 7 business days ahead, and we generally operate on net45 as a standard. Below are details and options so your team can decide what fits your AP workflow.

Requirements for a blanket PO to flow smoothly:
- PO must reference SOW number and deal id (please add DEAL-2026-0782 in the PO body)
- Include billing contact name/email and a remit-to address (I'll paste ours below)
- For AP mapping please add GL code column where possible; if you can't supply GL codes, include a line for "Account code" so we can map post-issuance

Term options (pick one):
1) Standard: Net45 on quarterly invoices (no discount) — fastest to approve on our side.
2) Net60: we can accept Net60 but would request a 2% price hold (no retroactive credits) to offset extended DSO.
3) Upfront annual prepay: 5% off list for full-year prepayment (we can generate a single invoice and mark subsequent quarterly invoices as zero-balance receipts).

Pre-invoice practice:
- We will generate a proforma PDF that looks like the invoice (labels "Proforma / Pre-invoice") and email it to procurement 7 business days before the invoice date. This helps with your internal signoff but is not the remittance invoice.

Please see attached draft SOW (SOW-Redwood-v1.pdf) — if you can return the PO referencing the SOW and the deal id, we can accept the PO and advance DocuSign for signature.

Redwood remit address for PO population:
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Accounts Receivable
123 Innovation Way
San Francisco, CA 94107
EIN: 94-1234567

If you'd like me to loop in our finance lead (Marissa) for final cadence confirmation, I cc'd her.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pre-invoice routing & PO guidance for Redwood annual commitment

Grace / team — quick commercial read: Nimbus is a strategic healthcare account (good reference value). A few points to consider before we lock terms: 

- Net60 impact: stretches DSO; finance will push back unless compensated. For a major account I would be comfortable offering net60 with a 2% price hold as you suggested.
- Discount trade: the 5% upfront is attractive but only if they actually prepay (collection risk otherwise). If they can do a 50% upfront and 50% at mid-year maybe we can do 3.5%? Worth asking.
- Contract language: ensure the PO references "quarterly invoice against blanket PO" and specifies what constitutes acceptance of a pre-invoice vs a final invoice.

Proposed reply to Elle: offer the three options (Net45, Net60+2% hold, or 5% for full upfront) and ask if they're open to a partial prepay (50%) to split risk. I can take the negotiation call if they want commercial-level signoff.

Short and actionable — happy to join a call.

-Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pre-invoice routing & PO guidance for Redwood annual commitment

Looping finance specifics: 

- Invoice cadence: we need clarity whether invoices will be issued at the beginning of each quarter (e.g., Jan 1, Apr 1) or the end (Mar 31). For revenue recognition we prefer invoices dated on the start of quarter; AP teams sometimes prefer end-of-quarter. Either works but please specify.
- Pre-invoice vs invoice: proforma/pre-invoice must be marked clearly as "Proforma - Not for Remittance". We can accept that for internal approval.
- First-invoice exception: we can allow a one-time net60 on the first invoice only if procurement agrees in writing. Subsequent invoices would revert to the agreed standard (Net45 or Net60+2% as negotiated).

Action items for procurement PO: please include PO number, billing contact, remit-to address (Grace provided), and if applicable note any discounts and whether prepay is expected. If they include tax or withholding language, we need a copy for our tax team early.

I can provide a sample invoice calendar once we know their preferred dating.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks Grace — this is very helpful. After a quick procurement/finance huddle here at Nimbus: 

- We will issue a blanket PO referencing DEAL-2026-0782 and the attached SOW.
- We will accept quarterly invoices dated at the start of each quarter (Jan 1 / Apr 1 / Jul 1 / Oct 1).
- Nimbus standard is net60; we can make a one-time written exception to allow the first invoice to be net60 and accept Net45 thereafter. Alternatively, if Redwood prefers Net60 for all invoices we can accept a 2% earlier-year price hold. Please confirm which you prefer.
- We will return the completed PO by end of day tomorrow; attached is the filled template (Nimbus_PO_filled.pdf).

Also: please send a proforma pre-invoice for the Q1 charge 7 business days before Jan 1, 2027 to procurement@nimbushealth.com. Once we receive that pre-invoice it moves to our AP review queue.

Appreciate the flexibility and the clear remit details. If you want to finalize discount tradeoffs, Ben — can you and Grace propose the commercial path and we'll sign off quickly.

Best,
Elle Thompson
Senior Procurement Manager
Nimbus Health
